summary: Frontend UI verification of the 4 new Sala Sitor features on https://edit-33.preview.emergentagent.com. All 4 features PASS. Board rendered with 5 operators; Michele & Antonio show 'DALLE 05:30' badges (board-shift-start-0 / -3); Ahmed, Sara, Luca show 'PIÙ TARDI · lun'. Sara appears in a red row with '+28′ OLTRE STIMA' and a visible 'Riassegna' button (board-reassign-2). Clicking Reassign produced toast 'Compito passato a Antonio' and the board updated: Sara returned to free/off-shift and Antonio picked up the task. Delays history toggle opens with Michele (1× +30′) and Sara (1× +28′). Header board-late-count shows '1 in ritardo'. LateNotifier is mounted globally (returns null); GET /api/worker/late-alerts returns 200 with Sara's alert. Toasts for NEW lates only appear after the first polling cycle by design.
critical_code_review_comments: OperatorStatusBoard.jsx (262 lines) is well-structured with all data-testid required by spec (board-reassign-N, board-shift-start-N, board-shift-later-N, delays-history-toggle, delays-history, delays-row-N, board-late-count, board-late-N). Reassign correctly guarded by o.late && !o.locked_by_capo.
LateNotifier.jsx correctly uses seen-set + first-cycle guard to avoid spamming existing lates; 25s polling as specced. Mounted only for admins per E1 note.

Minor: reassign() success path always shows toast even on non-200 responses that don't throw; delegationApi.reassign should surface 4xx as thrown errors to allow error toast. Verified success case is correct.
seed_data_creation: None; used pre-seeded state (Sara forced late, Michele/Antonio on-shift 05:30).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow (unchanged): POST /api/admin-gate/verify {pin:198505} → POST /api/auth/login → set localStorage(mikilab_admin_unlocked=1, mikilab_onboarded=1, mikilab_activity=panificio, mikilab_lang=it) → goto('/') with wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_timeout(6-7s). Sala Sitor is on landing; scrollIntoView on [data-testid=sala-sitor]. Board polls every 15s and LateNotifier every 25s — avoid networkidle.

test_results_detail.F1_riassegna_ritardi: PASS — board-reassign-2 visible on Sara's red row. Click → toast 'Compito passato a Antonio'. Board update: Sara becomes free/off-shift row, Antonio busy with the same task (~15′). API POST /api/worker/reassign wired via delegationApi.reassign.
test_results_detail.F2_turni_orario: PASS — board-shift-start-0 (Michele) and board-shift-start-3 (Antonio) render 'dalle 05:30'. board-shift-later-1/2/4 render 'Più tardi · lun' for Ahmed/Sara/Luca. Rows off-shift attenuated (opacity-60).
test_results_detail.F3_storico_ritardi: PASS — delays-history-toggle visible; click opens delays-history; delays-row-0 = Michele Forno 1× +30′; delays-row-1 = Sara Impastatore 1× +28′. GET /api/worker/delays/history?days=7 returns total_events=2, ranking length=2.
test_results_detail.F4_notifica_direzione: PASS — LateNotifier mounted in App (returns null, no DOM). GET /api/worker/late-alerts returns 200 with alerts=[{operator:'Sara', over_min:27+, id:'Sara|<task_id>|<date>'}]. First-cycle guard prevents duplicate toasts for already-in-progress lates — matches spec. No console errors from the notifier.
